task.title: Browse the settings catalog
task.shortdesc: Use Catalog mode to browse every supported policy and known managed preference for the selected schema.

prereq.p: Open a saved profile in All Settings.

context.p: Catalog mode is the full visual inventory. It includes configured and available settings while keeping advanced controls behind deliberate disclosures.

info.p: Expected result: the All Settings profile remains focused on the selected task.

step.cmd: Browse categories for supported policies and known managed preferences.

info.p: Expected result: the All Settings profile remains focused on the selected task.

step.cmd: Use category cards or search to narrow the inventory.

info.p: Expected result: the All Settings profile remains focused on the selected task.

step.cmd: Select a setting before applying, editing, or resetting a value.

info.note: Changing settings can affect the exported Firefox policy. Review source, validation, and schema support before saving.

result.p: You can find supported policies and known preferences without using raw JSON first.

postreq.p: Recovery: if the catalog is large, use search, filters, or bounded-list controls instead of scrolling blindly.
